title: Concept
description: A node in the concept DAG. Concepts are the unit of mastery: every graded artifact writes evidence against one or more concepts, and the session planner selects work by concept weakness.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Never reused, never renamed — mastery history is keyed on it.

description.description: What competence this concept represents, phrased as something you can demonstrate.

prereqs.description: Concept ids that should be solid before this one is drilled. Must form a DAG — the validator rejects cycles.

band.description: Rough tier. Advisory for session planning; it does not gate anything.

deprecated_at.description: Set instead of deleting. Deleting a concept would orphan its evidence rows.
